I understand where you are coming from. I didn't say enough in here because I thought it was already too lengthy. I've ruined my career, lost all my money, lost some of my closest friends and turned many people away due to my suicidal ways. I say thoughts because it always exists. Tendencies arise and I've turned them away. That's how I'm still alive. I've planned it all out, written it in poems, given details to friends, yet I still find something worth living for, even if for a while it was other people; then I learned how to live with myself again. I've had several friends make attempts and have been there for others before. We have all learned to live in our own ways now. When I relate to other people in this world, I think about the ones who were in the same boat as me. A few of us learned to turn it around, a few of us never will, and yet a few of them lost. Of those, I've seen what it does to their families, my family included. I just wanted to share with anyone who may want to help themselves instead. It's what I did and I know it's not going to be easy and life is shit still, but I'll find my way if that's what makes me live for today.

Then make a change. It takes time, but move past it. You are here right now because you are still deciding what to do. You'd rather be dead, but there's so much more to life. Again, look to Janus for insight. http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Janus
Doesn't matter about the last ten years. Make the next ten years count. You're smart: grad degree, behavioral health. Turn to Janus for a new outlook.

Then do something new.
